status: frozen before variational-source implementation and cluster scores

sample.target_interpretation: same-catalog conventional halo reconstruction, not direct pixel truth

projected_low_field_action.functional: F[psi]=integral[-|grad psi|^2/2-2 kappa_AQUAL psi+eta_sigma V(Ehat,M)] d^2x
projected_low_field_action.local_tide: E_ij=D_ij psi; D_ij=partial_i partial_j-delta_ij Laplacian/2; Ehat=E/tau_sigma
projected_low_field_action.shear_closure: delta_gamma is the Kaiser-Squires E-mode shear generated by delta_kappa
projected_low_field_action.screen: S=1 low-field projected limit; no convergence-derived or object-derived screening variable is introduced

numerics.fit_method: differential_evolution in log L_sigma and log tau_sigma with analytic nonnegative shared eta_sigma
numerics.score: equal-cluster mean of equal-channel normalized Fourier mean-square error over the inherited 18-500 kpc band

decision_rule.advance: all gates pass; then derive the exact 3D covariant normalization, high-field screen, causal memory completion, and principal kinetic matrix before opening a holdout
decision_rule.retire: any sign, phase, shared-transfer, boundary-stability, or manufactured-variation gate fails; do not tune the source sign or add per-cluster geometry

claim_boundary: This is a projected weak-field action-shape audit on two already-spent clusters, not an empirical validation or a complete covariant theory.

The fitted projected tensor scale tau_sigma is a proxy for the line-of-sight projection of the physical curvature scale a_sigma/L_sigma; a passing result must later derive that mapping rather than keep tau_sigma as an independent lensing constant.
AQUAL shear supplies the two-dimensional STF tide, so convergence/trace information enters only through the baseline and target, not the interaction invariant.
A two-dimensional Helmholtz memory is not the exact projection of a retarded four-dimensional operator.
The compact-halo target contains fitted external shear and is a useful spent decomposition, not direct truth.
The positive correction sign is fixed by the written projected functional; an unconstrained negative eta is a physical sign failure, not permission to flip the action.
No untouched galaxy or cluster evidence may be opened in this audit.
